comment: Governance maturity is discussed mainly as institutional capacity. Political commitment, administrative stability, corruption risk, procurement integrity, regulatory independence, and public trust may also determine whether formal governance structures work in practice.

public.text: Governance maturity is discussed mainly as institutional capacity. Political commitment, administrative stability, corruption risk, procurement integrity, regulatory independence, and public trust may also determine whether formal governance structures work in practice.
public.suggestedRevision: Acknowledge these contextual conditions and recommend risk-based mitigation, transparency measures, independent oversight, audit, public reporting, and staged delegation of authority.
